position_revisions.why: The frame (how the intake rota and pantry restocking run, and from when) still holds. Dario's statement that the pantry restocks any shelf below a third full is no longer wholly correct. Oats and rice now restock at half full, and the one-third rule stays for every other shelf. The new segment replaces the blanket rule with this threshold-plus-exception, as the earlier overlap-call length was replaced.
